requirements.text: Patients should be able to book, cancel, and reschedule their appointments online
Patients should be able to view available time slots for various appointment types (GP, nurse, urgent)
Patients should have the option to flag urgent symptoms during the booking process
The appointment booking system must integrate seamlessly with existing practice management software
Patients should receive automated reminders via their preferred communication method (text, email, phone call)
Patients should have a dedicated section in the portal to view their current medications
Patients should be able to add notes or comments regarding their prescription requests
System should trigger automatic alerts to the clinical team upon submission of prescription requests for clinician review and approval
Patients should receive confirmation notifications when their prescription requests are received and approved
Patients should be able to request changes to their prescriptions through the portal
Access to test results should be granted only after clinician review and authorization
There should be a user-friendly section in the portal for patients to view their approved test results
Patients should have the ability to ask questions or request follow-up appointments through the portal regarding their test results
Patients should receive notifications when their test results are available for viewing
The portal must have strong security measures, including encrypted communications and secure identity verification
The portal design should be simple and intuitive with clear navigation
The portal should use large, readable fonts and high-contrast colors for better visibility
Tutorials or guided tours should be provided for first-time users
The portal must be mobile-friendly and work well on smartphones and tablets
Multiple communication channels for support should be available, such as a helpline or chat feature
Feedback mechanisms for continuous improvement should be integrated into the portal
The system must comply with GDPR and data protection regulations to protect patient information
